_comment: Base Claude Code settings owned by mewai. The allow, ask, and deny arrays under permissions are generated from core/policy/policy.json by scripts/render.ps1 and must not be set here. Everything else under permissions, including defaultMode, is yours to edit.

permissions._comment: auto mode is what makes the three-tier policy work. Ask rules prompt, deny rules block, and allow rules resolve without reaching the classifier. Under bypassPermissions the ask tier is silently inert. Do not set disableAutoMode here: it turns auto mode off.
